## Purpose and Deployment Entry Points
mailcow: dockerized is a self-hosted mail-server stack packaged as coordinated Docker Compose services. Operational entry points are `docker-compose.yml`, initial environment/config generation via `generate_config.sh`, lifecycle/update automation in `update.sh`, and cold-standby provisioning through `create_cold_standby.sh`.

## Compose-Orchestrated Service Boundary
`docker-compose.yml` is the system integration boundary: it wires separately built mail, web, storage, security, DNS, certificate, and operations containers. Service images are defined under `data/Dockerfiles/`; optional deployment topology/features are supplied as Compose overrides under `helper-scripts/docker-compose.override.yml.d/`, including HAProxy, external DNS/MySQL socket, and Prometheus exporter variants.

## Mail Transport and Delivery Pipeline
Inbound/outbound SMTP traffic is handled by Postfix, with its container startup and transport behavior in `data/Dockerfiles/postfix/docker-entrypoint.sh` and `data/Dockerfiles/postfix/postfix.sh`; base MTA policy is in `data/conf/postfix/main.cf`. Mail passes through Rspamd-based filtering and ClamAV scanning before Dovecot mailbox storage/access. TLS-policy support is separated into `data/Dockerfiles/postfix-tlspol/`.

## Mailbox, Groupware, and Data Services
Dovecot provides IMAP/mailbox functions, Sieve-related processing, quota/quarantine notifications, and maintenance jobs; its runtime boundary begins at `data/Dockerfiles/dovecot/docker-entrypoint.sh` and configuration is rooted at `data/conf/dovecot/dovecot.conf`. SOGo supplies groupware/webmail integration via `data/Dockerfiles/sogo/docker-entrypoint.sh` and `data/conf/sogo/sogo.conf`. MySQL configuration and initialization assets reside in `data/conf/mysql/my.cnf` and `data/assets/mysql/docker-entrypoint.sh`; Redis configuration is under `data/conf/redis/`.

## Filtering, DNS, Certificates, and Network Enforcement
Rspamd is the central spam-policy engine, configured through `data/conf/rspamd/rspamd.conf.local` and rule fragments such as `data/conf/rspamd/local.d/actions.conf`; dynamic maps bridge filtering decisions to PHP-backed administrative data. Unbound provides internal DNS resolution (`data/Dockerfiles/unbound/docker-entrypoint.sh`, `data/conf/unbound/unbound.conf`). ACME certificate acquisition/renewal is encapsulated by `data/Dockerfiles/acme/obtain-certificate.sh`. Network enforcement is delegated to a privileged netfilter service supporting iptables/nftables in `data/Dockerfiles/netfilter/main.py`.

## Web Administration and API Control Plane
Nginx fronts the PHP-FPM application; templated proxy configuration is in `data/conf/nginx/templates/nginx.conf.j2`, with container bootstrap at `data/Dockerfiles/nginx/bootstrap.py`. The PHP application serves administrator, domain-admin, and user interfaces from `data/web/`, with shared initialization/database access in `data/web/inc/init_db.inc.php`. Its primary machine interface is `data/web/json_api.php`, documented by `data/web/api/openapi.yaml`; OAuth endpoints are under `data/web/oauth/`.

## Operations, Docker Control, and Extensibility
The Docker API service (`data/Dockerfiles/dockerapi/main.py`) exposes controlled container operations to the management plane, while Watchdog performs service/DNS/database health checks through `data/Dockerfiles/watchdog/watchdog.sh`. Backup is a dedicated container defined by `data/Dockerfiles/backup/Dockerfile`, with operator workflows in `helper-scripts/backup_and_restore.sh`. Administrators can inject runtime extensions through service-specific hook directories under `data/hooks/`, avoiding direct modification of container images or base configuration.
